content_variants.text:
Turkish bombardment | Civilian killed and three others, including children, injured in Ain Issa countryside

SOHR activists have documented the death of a civilian and injury of three others, including two children, in rocket attacks by Turkish forces stationed in “Peace Spring” area, which targeted Al-Houshan village in the west of Ain Issa district, the “capital” of the Autonomous Administration in the northern countryside of Al-Raqqah.

On Saturday, Syrian Observatory activists have reported intensive rocket fire by Turkish forces and “National Army” factions targeting Sayda village and M4 international highway in the countryside of Ain Issa district, the “capital” of the Autonomous Administration in the north of Al-Raqqah. The Turkish shelling coincided with the arrival of a Russian convoy at Ain Issa base.

On that day, SOHR activists documented the death of a civilian in rocket attacks by Turkish forces on Jarad village in the northern countryside of Manbij in the east of Aleppo.
